original_test_intent: Demonstrate stable 12-hour CPU0 and CPU1 operation at 40C and -5% 5V/3.3V rails, with expected socket power behavior and no compute, RAS or platform errors.
original_method: Map sockets, NUMA nodes, cores and power/thermal sensors; approve a dual-socket stress profile and define the maximum-watt domain, statistic, target and tolerance for negative margin; establish a preserved baseline, ramp the chamber and rails under controlled load, maintain per-socket load for 12 hours with power/frequency/thermal/throttle/RAS telemetry, then stop safely and restore nominal conditions.
manual_activity: Operator controls chamber/rails, supervises both sockets under load and performs safe restoration.
required_inputs: Stress tool/version/profile and per-socket load floor
40C/-5% rail measurement points, ramp and tolerance
Frequency, throttle, thermal and RAS limits
Heartbeat, OOB abort and restoration plan
safety_requirements: Use calibrated electrical and thermal telemetry
Abort on runaway temperature, loss of heartbeat, severe RAS or rail instability
Do not clear prior logs; delimit the test window
Return stress, rails and chamber to nominal in controlled order
agent_execution_scope: May verify topology and analyze supplied per-socket telemetry
Must not control lab equipment or assign PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Approve limits and supervise the margin run

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects remote-only execution but does not define how both sockets or maximum watts are proven.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Operator runs the pinned socket-affined stress profile only after the dual-socket and power-oracle contract is approved.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: CPU0 and CPU1, 40C, -5% 5V/3.3V and 12 hours are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use socket-affined workers and correlate per-socket utilization, frequency, power and RAS with the measured negative-rail interval.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit socket coverage, interpretable power criterion, bounded aborts and restoration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Aggregate host utilization can hide an idle or throttled socket, and nominal-voltage power cannot substitute for -5% evidence.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: At undervoltage the platform may cap frequency or power, so 'match the max' is not meaningful until the sensor domain and tolerance are defined.

project_override_considerations: Platform owner decides whether maximum means design/TDP, a telemetry cap, steady-state mean or observed peak and how low-voltage protection affects acceptance.
expected_evidence: Stress binary/config checksum and worker affinity
Per-socket utilization, frequency, power, thermal and throttling time series
Tool result plus kernel/MCE/RAS/BMC event deltas

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently requests dual-CPU negative-margin stress; the maximum-watt phrase is underspecified rather than internally contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The test purpose and physical method are clear; the undefined watt oracle prevents a verdict but can be supplied as an engineering input without blocking static review.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Stability row23 Wistron-Margin-00022-V002: approve CPU0/CPU1 core/NUMA/sensor map, stress tool/version/profile and 12-hour per-socket load floor, define 'CPU watts max' sensor/domain/statistic/target/tolerance at 40C/-5% rails, thermal/throttle/RAS/heartbeat aborts and nominal restoration.

review_improvement: Makes both socket coverage and the otherwise ambiguous maximum-watt criterion measurable under negative margin.
independent_technical_reasoning: A whole-system stress process can concentrate work on one NUMA node while the other socket remains partially idle. Separately, voltage-margin controls can change boost and power-limit behavior. Per-socket affinity and correlated frequency/power telemetry are therefore necessary before interpreting the stated maximum-watt expectation.
